scripts.dev:full: pnpm infra:up && sh -c 'trap "pnpm infra:down" EXIT INT TERM; pnpm dev'
scripts.dev:api: dotenv -e .env -- dotnet watch --solution DocSign.sln run --project apps/api/src/Api /p:SolutionDir=$PWD/
scripts.gen:check: pnpm gen && git diff --exit-code -- apps/api/openapi.json packages/api-client/src
scripts.build: pnpm build:api && pnpm gen:types && pnpm build:web
scripts.db:add: dotnet ef migrations add --project apps/api/src/Infrastructure --startup-project apps/api/src/Api
scripts.db:migrate: dotnet ef database update --project apps/api/src/Infrastructure --startup-project apps/api/src/Api
scripts.clean: dotnet clean DocSign.slnx && pnpm -r exec rimraf dist node_modules/.vite
